race.comment: ONE PEPPER (2) wound up strongly last time out to finish a neck adrift in second over 1200m at this track when returning from a spell. Should be prominent from the outset. Placed 3/3 so far including 2/2 course and distance. Take catching. SENSEI OF SPIN (3) is a three-year-old gelding facing the starter for the first time. Out of Group 3 winner Sarasota. Is one of the main hopes. A M C ROY ON FIRE (7) just missed last time out when third over 1000m at this track. The extra journey should play into his hands. Poses a serious threat. ESCAPE VELOCITY (6) is a three-year-old colt on debut from the stable of Stuart Ferrie. By Malmoos from Arcetri Pink. Watch the market closely.
